parent_objective: design grounded target mining for belief-only capability-action coupling candidates

public_gates: define terminal-boundary or route-risk grounding criteria
forbid treating belief-only gaps as direct action targets
keep actor training and PPO blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train in design milestone
do not add privileged actor inputs
do not create action targets without simulator-grounded margin or risk improvement
hypothesis: M604 belief-only gaps are useful only if local recovery or terminal-boundary search can ground them in action targets that improve margin or risk without violating the actor contract.
success_criteria: design specifies target mining commands and artifacts
design specifies action search trust region and acceptance thresholds
design distinguishes normal-branch repair from wrong-history branch preservation
design keeps training blocked until target mining passes
failure_criteria: design treats M604 candidates as labels
design lacks margin or risk acceptance criteria
design permits target mining from private holdout

commands.name: design
commands.command: Write grounded capability-action target mining design; no training.

decision_rule: M605 passes if it pre-registers simulator-grounded action target mining before any action-coupling optimizer.
